findings.text: follow-on: _NAME_IDS_QUERY at harmonize.py:527 and _known_name_ids at harmonize.py:530 duplicate the capability the repository already owns at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:865 get_existing_standard_names, whose body is the same statement 'MATCH (sn:StandardName) RETURN sn.id AS id' returning a set of ids; the addition neither calls nor extends that owner (it hardcodes its own query string), so the all-name-id read now has two implementations that can drift. The stated reason (the owner opens its own client) is real friction but the remedy is to extend the owner to accept a client, not to fork the query; the behaviour is correct and does not hold the node.

follow-on: 'known_ids = _known_name_ids(gc) if gc is not None else None' at harmonize.py:573 keeps the pre-change scope-only deadness whenever gc is None, and gc's default in the signature at harmonize.py:537 is None, so a gc-less caller silently reverts to counting an out-of-scope but valid link as dead; the production caller imas_codex/cli/sn.py:6241 passes gc so the shipped path is correct, but the fallback is untested and re-introduces the defect the node exists to remove.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a report link be dead only when the graph has no such name: run_link_integrity now takes a known_ids set (imas_codex/standard_names/review/audits.py:406, used for the dead-link test at audits.py:457) and report_family_rows supplies the graph-wide StandardName id set via _known_name_ids (imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py:530,573,586), so an out-of-scope but valid reference is no longer counted as dead.

justifications.evidence: the gate the done_when names ran at both revisions and is recorded, not claimed: base_gate.log ends '68 passed' at a7de878b2cfb4837b23b7742cf8378d58a66a54e and head_gate.log ends '72 passed' at 73bbd94ba6ae777e1995fd582a5f06ad993dbf78, with the four added tests at tests/standard_names/test_report_graph_links.py in the head arm and negative_control.log retained.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py:527 follows the module's module-level-query-constant idiom and harmonize.py:530 names the helper by what it does, introducing no plan, sprint or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/review/audits.py:427 sets all_ids from known_ids for the dead-link test while audits.py:471 keeps the missing-reverse test on scope_ids, and imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py:586 passes the graph-wide set, exactly meeting the node's one-sentence deliverable.
